seo_description: Dev tool that automates UE clean builds. Cleans cache, regenerates project files, recompiles from scratch. One click.
hero.title: Unreal Engine Rebuilder
hero.subtitle: Dev Tool / Automation / Clean Build, Cache Cleanup, Project Regeneration
about.text: Unreal corrupts its own intermediate files more often than it should. You get linker errors, stale caches, builds that worked yesterday and fail today for no reason. The fix is always the same: delete Binaries, Intermediate, Saved, regenerate the VS solution, recompile. That's 15 minutes of clicking through folders. I automated the whole thing. One button clears the cache, regenerates project files, and kicks off a clean compile. It also shows you how much disk space each folder eats and cleans the DDC cache (that thing grows to gigabytes if you don't watch it). Auto-detects UE 4.x and 5.x installations.

features.rebuild_desc: Wipes Binaries, Intermediate, Saved. Regenerates the VS solution. Compiles from scratch.
features.backup_desc: Archives Source, Config, Content, and Plugins with a timestamp before doing anything.
features.disk_desc: Shows folder sizes so you can see what's eating space. Clears DDC cache. Frees gigabytes.
features.detect_desc: Finds UE installations on your machine. Handles both 4.x and 5.x.
features.logs_desc: Timestamps every operation. You can trace exactly what happened.
features.ui_desc: Simple interface. Console output updates in real-time.
